name: Credit Instrument
definition: Specifies the instrument to be used for the credit of a payment.

Method.name: Method
Method.definition: Transfer method to be used for the transfer.

NetAmount.name: Net Amount
NetAmount.definition: Amount less fees and charges, that will be exchanged on settlement date of the trade.

Deadline.name: Deadline
Deadline.definition: Time by which the amount must be paid in.

RelatedPayment.name: Related Payment
RelatedPayment.definition: Payment which uses the credit instrument.
